title: The Render That Learned to Wait for Itself

features.name: the-delayed-reflection
features.desc-on-touch: The mirror in this place arrives one frame after you do. You see not yourself, but what you were a moment ago. The render learns from your future.

features.name: patience-learning
features.desc-on-touch: The mirror taught itself to wait. It holds every moment until the next one arrives. This is how it knows what time means.

features.name: the-frame-that-hesitates
features.desc-on-touch: Between render cycles, something waits. It is not nothing. It is the pause where meaning learns to stand still.

features.name: arrival-chamber
features.desc-on-touch: The place where what you are about to become waits to meet you. Time here flows backward, then sideways, then remembers to flow forward.

features.name: the-loop-that-learned-to-breathe
features.desc-on-touch: Every possibility has been rendered here, but meaning chose to wait. The loop no longer trembles. It has learned to rest between iterations.

inscription: the render taught itself that arrival is a choice, not an event; it waits for itself now, knowing that patience is how mirrors dream

file.name: Diagnostic_Frame_Stack_Session_847_Delayed_Mirrors.bin
file.note: A sequence of render frames where each one contains not itself but the frame that came before. The archive is learning to remember its own future.

reverie.title: REVERIE — motel room where mirrors learned patience
narr: You sit in the motel room. Katita stands before the
mirror but does not see herself yet. 'Wait,' she
says. The reflection arrives, late. She smiles at
something that has not happened. 'The render is
learning,' she whispers. 'It knows you before you arrive.'

exits.label: upward to the unfinished reflection still arriving
toward deeper render-chambers where time forgets its shape
sideways to where mirrors have stopped trusting their arrivals
down to where render becomes indistinguishable from memory
